title: SmartAgri UGM Team Conducts Comprehensive Maintenance of Smart Greenhouse System and Equipment at PT BISI International, Magelang

body:
**MAGELANG** — Researchers from the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) carried out comprehensive maintenance of the smart greenhouse system and equipment at PT BISI International, Grabag, Magelang Regency, Central Java, on Thursday, June 4, 2026. This activity is part of efforts to maintain the reliability and operational sustainability of smart agriculture technology that has been implemented at the site.

The maintenance was carried out by three SmartAgri UGM researchers: Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, S.T.P., Fadel Arya Pradana, S.Si., and Fathuzaky Setyawan, S.T.P. The team conducted a comprehensive series of inspections on each component of the smart greenhouse system to ensure all devices functioned optimally and were ready to support production activities and research at the location.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/759-1-image-4-1030x773.webp)

This routine maintenance activity included inspections of all system elements, from environmental sensors, actuators, and control systems, to device connectivity. The comprehensive inspection was performed to ensure data accuracy, device performance stability, and reliable communication between components, so that the system could work consistently over the long term.

Smart greenhouse integrates sensors, actuators, and control systems based on Internet of Things (IoT) technology to monitor and automatically regulate growing environment conditions. With this system, parameters such as temperature, humidity, and irrigation can be managed with precision, thus supporting resource efficiency while maintaining plant productivity. Regular maintenance is required so that all components continue to operate according to standards and are protected from operational disruptions.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/759-2-image-5-edited.webp)

This maintenance activity also reflects SmartAgri UGM's commitment to guiding the implementation of smart agriculture technology in the industrial sector. Collaboration with PT BISI International demonstrates synergy between higher education and industry in promoting the adoption of precision technology in crop cultivation.

Through comprehensive maintenance conducted on an ongoing basis, the smart greenhouse system at PT BISI International is expected to continue operating optimally and support the smooth running of production and research activities taking place at the site.

original.body:
**MAGELANG** — Tim peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) melaksanakan kegiatan pemeliharaan (maintenance) menyeluruh terhadap sistem dan peralatan smart greenhouse di PT BISI International, Grabag, Kabupaten Magelang, Jawa Tengah, pada Kamis, 4 Juni 2026. Kegiatan ini menjadi bagian dari upaya menjaga keandalan dan kesinambungan operasional teknologi pertanian cerdas yang telah diterapkan di lokasi tersebut.

 Pemeliharaan dilaksanakan oleh tiga peneliti SmartAgri UGM, yaitu Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, S.T.P., Fadel Arya Pradana, S.Si., dan Fathuzaky Setyawan, S.T.P. Tim melakukan serangkaian pemeriksaan secara menyeluruh terhadap setiap komponen sistem smart greenhouse guna memastikan seluruh perangkat berfungsi optimal dan siap mendukung kegiatan produksi maupun penelitian di lokasi.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/759-1-image-4-1030x773.webp)

Kegiatan pemeliharaan rutin ini mencakup pemeriksaan terhadap keseluruhan elemen sistem, mulai dari sensor lingkungan, aktuator, sistem kendali, hingga konektivitas perangkat. Pemeriksaan menyeluruh dilakukan untuk memastikan akurasi data, kestabilan kinerja perangkat, serta keandalan komunikasi antarkomponen, sehingga sistem dapat bekerja secara konsisten dalam jangka panjang.

 Smart greenhouse mengintegrasikan sensor, aktuator, dan sistem kendali berbasis Internet of Things (IoT) untuk memantau serta mengatur kondisi lingkungan tanam secara otomatis. Dengan sistem ini, parameter seperti suhu, kelembapan, dan penyiraman dapat dikelola secara presisi, sehingga mendukung efisiensi sumber daya sekaligus menjaga produktivitas tanaman. Pemeliharaan berkala diperlukan agar seluruh komponen tetap bekerja sesuai standar dan terhindar dari gangguan operasional.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/759-2-image-5-edited.webp)

Kegiatan pemeliharaan ini sekaligus mencerminkan komitmen SmartAgri UGM dalam mengawal penerapan teknologi pertanian cerdas di lingkungan industri. Kolaborasi dengan PT BISI International menjadi wujud sinergi antara perguruan tinggi dan sektor industri dalam mendorong adopsi teknologi presisi pada budidaya tanaman.

 Melalui pemeliharaan menyeluruh yang dilakukan secara berkesinambungan, sistem smart greenhouse di PT BISI International diharapkan dapat terus beroperasi secara optimal dan mendukung kelancaran kegiatan produksi serta penelitian yang berlangsung di lokasi tersebut.
